text_en: About that time King Herod laid violent hands upon some who belonged to the church.
text_cn: 在那个时期，黑落德王已下手磨难教会中的一些人，

text_en: He had James, the brother of John, killed with the sword.
text_cn: 用剑杀了若望的哥哥雅各伯。

text_en: After he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to arrest Peter also. (This was during the festival of Unleavened Bread. )
text_cn: 他一看到犹太人喜欢，便命人连伯多禄也加以拘捕，时正值无酵节日；

text_en: When he had seized him, he put him in prison and handed him over to four squads of soldiers to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
text_cn: 把他拿住以后，就押在监狱中，交由四班兵士──每班四人──看守，愿意在逾越节后，给百姓提出来。

text_en: While Peter was kept in prison, the church prayed fervently to God for him.
text_cn: 伯多禄就被看管在监狱中，而教会恳切为他向天主祈祷。

text_en: The very night before Herod was going to bring him out, Peter, bound with two chains, was sleeping between two soldiers, while guards in front of the door were keeping watch over the prison.
text_cn: 及至黑落德将要提出他的时候，那一夜伯多禄被两道锁链缚着，睡在两个士兵中，门前还有卫兵把守监狱。

text_en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him, saying, “Get up quickly. ” And the chains fell off his wrists.
text_cn: 忽然，主的一位天使显现，有一道光，照亮了房间，天使拍着伯多禄的肋膀，唤醒他说：“快快起来！”锁链遂从他手上落下来。

text_en: The angel said to him, “Fasten your belt and put on your sandals. ” He did so. Then he said to him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me. ”
text_cn: 天使向他说：“束上腰，穿上你的鞋！”他都照办了。天使吩咐他说：“披上你的外氅(chǎng)，跟我来罢！”

text_en: Peter went out and followed him; he did not realize that what was happening with the angel’s help was real; he thought he was seeing a vision.
text_cn: 他就出来跟着走，还不知道天使所行的是实在的事，只想是见了异像。

text_en: After they had passed the first and the second guard, they came before the iron gate leading into the city. It opened for them of its own accord, and they went outside and walked along a lane, when suddenly the angel left him.
text_cn: 他们经过第一道岗，又第二道，来到通到城的铁门前，铁门就自动地给他们开了；他们便出去，往前走了一条街，忽然天使离开他，不见了。

text_en: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I am sure that the Lord has sent his angel and rescued me from the hands of Herod and from all that the Jewish people were expecting. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄这才清醒过来，说：“现今我实在知道主派了他的天使来，救我脱免黑落德的手和犹太人民所希望的事。”

text_en: As soon as he realized this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose other name was Mark, where many had gathered and were praying.
text_cn: 他既明白过来，就往若望──号称马尔谷──的母亲玛利亚的家去，在那里有好些人聚集祈祷。

text_en: When he knocked at the outer gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.
text_cn: 他敲大门的时候，有一个名叫洛德的使女过来听。

text_en: On recognizing Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that, instead of opening the gate, she ran in and announced that Peter was standing at the gate.
text_cn: 她一认出是伯多禄的声音，喜的没有开门，就跑进去报告说：伯多禄站在大门前。

text_en: They said to her, “You are out of your mind! ” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel. ”
text_cn: 他们都对她说：“你疯了！”她却坚持说：实在是这样。他们反说：“是他的天使。”

text_en: Meanwhile Peter continued knocking; and when they opened the gate, they saw him and were amazed.
text_cn: 伯多禄还不住的敲门；他们一开门，看见是他，都惊呆了。

text_en: He motioned to them with his hand to be silent, and described for them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he added, “Tell this to James and to the believers. ” Then he left and went to another place.
text_cn: 伯多禄摆手叫他们不要作声，遂给他们述说上主怎样领他出了监狱，且说：“你们要把这些事报告给雅各伯和弟兄们。”他便出去，往别的地方去了。

text_en: When morning came, there was no small commotion among the soldiers over what had become of Peter.
text_cn: 天一亮，在士兵中，起了不小的骚乱，不知伯多禄出了什么事。

text_en: When Herod had searched for him and could not find him, he examined the guards and ordered them to be put to death. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there.
text_cn: 黑落德遂搜寻他，搜寻不到，就审讯卫兵，下令把他们处决了。 以后，黑落德从犹太下到凯撒勒雅，住在那里。

text_en: Now Herod was angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. So they came to him in a body; and after winning over Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for a reconciliation, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
text_cn: 那时，黑落德向提洛和漆冬发了大怒；二城的人商量好，来见他，并贿赂了管王卧房的布拉斯托去求和，因为他们那一方当由君王这里获得食粮。

text_en: On an appointed day Herod put on his royal robes, took his seat on the platform, and delivered a public address to them.
text_cn: 黑落德在约定的日子，披戴君王的礼服，坐在宝座上向他们演讲。

text_en: The people kept shouting, “The voice of a god, and not of a mortal! ”
text_cn: 人民便呼喊说：“这不是人的声音，而是神的声音。”

text_en: And immediately, because he had not given the glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
text_cn: 立刻有上主的天使打击了他，因为他没有归光荣于天主。他为虫子所吃，遂断了气。

text_en: But the word of God continued to advance and gain adherents.
text_cn: 天主的道却逐渐发扬广大。

text_en: Then after completing their mission Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem and brought with them John, whose other name was Mark.
text_cn: 巴尔纳伯和扫禄完成了任务，就带着号称马尔谷的若望从耶路撒冷回去了。
